name: Sparse amapiano four + ghost shakers
desc: Soft 909 four-on-the-floor with lots of air around it, riding a busy sixteenth-note shaker layer whose per-step ghost-note gains give it the human amapiano sway. Offbeat rim in sparse; rim + clap on the backbeat and a masked open hat by peak. Space is the point.

kickcut.doc: kick lpf Hz - lower = softer amapiano thud

code.full: stack(s("bd*4").bank("RolandTR909").shape(.3).lpf(${kickcut}).gain(${gain}), s("sh*16").gain(".5 .18 .34 .22 .42 .18 .3 .24 .5 .18 .34 .22 .4 .2 .3 .26").hpf(500).lpf(sine.range(${shkcut}*.6, ${shkcut}*1.1).slow(24)).pan(cosine.range(.35,.65).slow(16)).room(.15).every(8, x=>x.ply(2)), s("~ rim ~ rim").gain(${gain}*.5).room(.2), s("~ cp ~ cp").gain(${gain}*.4).room(.25)).fast(${rate}).orbit(1).play()
code.peak: stack(s("bd*4").bank("RolandTR909").shape(.34).lpf(${kickcut}*1.3).gain(${gain}), s("sh*16").gain(".55 .2 .38 .24 .48 .2 .34 .26 .55 .2 .38 .24 .46 .22 .34 .3").hpf(500).lpf(sine.range(${shkcut}*.7, ${shkcut}*1.3).slow(16)).pan(cosine.range(.3,.7).slow(16)).every(8, x=>x.ply(2)), s("~ rim ~ rim").gain(${gain}*.5).room(.2), s("~ cp ~ cp").gain(${gain}*.42).room(.25), s("[~ oh]*4").gain(saw.range(.12, .3).fast(4)).lpf(9000).room(.2).mask("<1 1 1 0>")).fast(${rate}).orbit(1).play()
